page.overview:
Who is Seth Goldberg?

Captain Seth Goldberg was a Starfleet officer who served during the mid-24th century. In 2364, he was the commander of the .

After stardate 41607.9, he received an order about the exploration of Gamma Argus II from Vice Admiral Maxwell Headroom of Starfleet Planetary Geosciences Division. This admiral requested an acknowledgement of this order from the captain on subspace com net security code 045, code 100 alpha. (, okudagram)
